scope: every name the web 3D library's WebGL entry exports at 0.186.0, through its re-exports, and the rounded-box addon; parameters are each mapped name's constructor arguments, or the properties its constructor sets from one parameters object

names.name: Fog
names.target: sky@1 with `fog_curve: {linear: {near, far}}`, whose ramp is a straight line over the distance from the eye where the library's is a smoothstep over depth

names.name: Group
names.target: group@1 as itself, an item its children name in `parent` that draws nothing and gives them its transform

names.name: InstancedMesh
names.target: instance@1, whose `of` names the item that stands for the geometry and its material and whose `pos`, `rot` and `scale` hold a row for each element where the library takes a setMatrixAt call

names.name: Line
names.target: mark.line@1, whose `points` are the geometry's positions in metres

names.name: Mesh
names.target: the geometry word's own item, familiar.box@1 and the rest, which draws as the mesh and names the material word's item in its `material`

names.name: MeshPhongMaterial
names.target: familiar.standard_material@1, whose roughness shapes the highlight where the library's `specular` and `shininess` shape a Blinn-Phong lobe ours never draws

names.name: MeshToonMaterial
names.target: familiar.standard_material@1, which lights a surface in one continuous lobe where the library's gradient map lights it in bands

names.name: Points
names.target: mark.point@1, one item a point or its `chunks` for many, at the geometry's positions in metres

names.name: Scene
names.target: the document itself, whose items are the scene's children and whose one sky@1 holds the background, the ambient light and the fog

names.name: ShaderMaterial
names.target: material@1, whose fields say what a surface is, or a material operator a pack composes from the public steps, since nothing of ours runs shader text as written

names.name: Sprite
names.target: mark.image@1, a picture by its hash on one quad at the item's place, turned to the view and sized on screen or in metres

names.name: TorusKnotGeometry
names.target: tube@1 along a curve@1 through the knot's own points, since no builder sweeps a (p, q) knot

params.name: MeshBasicMaterial
params.target: material@1's `maps.base_color`, the picture by its hash

params.name: MeshLambertMaterial
params.target: material@1's `maps.base_color`, the picture by its hash

params.name: MeshLambertMaterial
params.target: material@1's `maps.occlusion`, the picture by its hash

params.name: MeshLambertMaterial
params.target: material@1's `maps.emission`, the picture by its hash

params.name: MeshLambertMaterial
params.target: material@1's `normal_map`, the picture by its hash
